assessments.reasoning: ASF destination event 97db8d4f7ce042ee89cb89311bb642fd, bytes [1097,1492), contains the entire operative clause, the acknowledgment crediting the Apache Software Foundation and both placement provisions. Its mandatory and permissive sentences resolve the incomplete introductory summary for this clause-specific claim.

challenge.method: Tested included documentation, absent documentation, a program with customary acknowledgment locations and a program without them. Compared the operative clause with the introduction’s “only in their documentation” summary.
challenge.results: “If any” qualifies the included documentation and supplies no duty to create it. “Alternately” permits software placement even when documentation exists. Its “if and wherever” qualification rules out treating any arbitrary software location as sufficient. The introduction omits this express alternative.

limitations: The example supplies no facts about an actual distribution’s documentation or the places where a particular program normally displays acknowledgments.
reasoning: Clause 3 requires the specified ASF acknowledgment in end-user documentation included with redistribution, if any. It expressly permits an alternative in the software itself, “if and wherever such third-party acknowledgments normally appear”.
